name: Confirm Modal
description: Generic confirmation dialog returning Promise<boolean>. Shows a message (HTML-supported but sanitized — strips script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and on* event attributes). Has Cancel button and configurable confirm button (default 'Delete'). Overlay click = cancel (false). DOM is removed on resolution, not just hidden. Escape key cancels. Cancel button initially focused.

interface.constructor: constructor(message: string, confirmLabel?: string, destructive?: boolean) — Creates .modal-overlay.confirm containing .modal (role=dialog, aria-modal) > .modal-body > .confirm-modal-msg + .modal-actions (#confirm-cancel Cancel button + #confirm-ok button). Sanitizes message HTML by stripping script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and on* event attributes. Confirm button gets .btn-ok-destructive class if destructive=true. Registers cancel button click → done(false), ok button click → done(true), overlay click (target===overlay) → done(false). Appends overlay to document.body.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Sets overlay display:flex, registers Escape keydown listener that calls done(false), focuses the Cancel button (#confirm-cancel), returns a Promise that resolves with true (confirmed) or false (cancelled).

methods.name: done
methods.description: Removes Escape keydown listener, removes overlay element from DOM via .remove(), resolves the stored promise with ok value.

lifecycle.created_by: FileExplorerPlugin.deletePath() — new instance created per confirmation invocation
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Permanently removed from DOM on resolution (confirm or cancel) — overlay.remove() in done()
